items.exampleEn: Reading the questions first is a good test strategy.
items.exampleZh: 先讀題目是一個不錯的考試策略。

items.exampleEn: The truth is, I forgot your birthday.
items.exampleZh: 老實說，我忘了你的生日。

items.exampleEn: Every rule in our class has a purpose.
items.exampleZh: 我們班上的每條規定都有它的目的。
每個人都有不同的意見。

items.exampleEn: Being tall is an advantage in basketball.
items.exampleZh: 長得高在籃球比賽中是一項優勢。

items.exampleEn: This is a private affair, so please don't ask.
Nothing is impossible if you try.
items.exampleZh: 只要肯努力，沒有什麼是不可能的。

items.audioEn: In my opinion, the blue shirt looks better.
items.audioZh: 我覺得藍色那件襯衫比較好看。
items.questionZh: 說話的人覺得哪件比較好看？

items.sentenceEn: It's impossible to finish this work in one day.
items.sentenceZh: 一天之內不可能做完這些工作。

items.sentenceEn: My uncle reads about world affairs every morning.
items.sentenceZh: 我叔叔每天早上都會看國際時事。

items.stemEn: The coach told us our ____ for the next game.
items.stemZh: 教練告訴我們下一場比賽的策略。

items.stemEn: One ____ of living near school is that you can sleep longer.
items.stemZh: 住在學校附近的一個好處是可以多睡一點。

items.passageEn: Our class had a debate: is it better to live in a city or in the countryside? Each team planned a strategy before the debate. My team said the biggest advantage of the city is the good buses. The other team said cities are too noisy, and that is the truth. Our teacher explained the purpose of the debate: "Listen to other opinions." In the end, it was impossible to decide!
items.passageZh: 我們班舉辦了一場辯論：住在城市好，還是住在鄉下好？辯論前，每一隊都擬定了策略。我們這隊說城市最大的優點是公車很方便。另一隊說城市太吵，這也是事實。老師解釋這場辯論的目的：「聽聽別人的意見。」到最後，根本不可能分出高下！

questions.questionZh: 作者這一隊說城市最大的優點是什麼？
老師說辯論的目的是什麼？

rubricZh: 問句可寫例如 What is your opinion?

items.promptZh: 這個房間沒有特別的用途。
referenceEn: This room has no special purpose.
This room doesn't have a special purpose.
rubricZh: 「沒有」可寫，例如 has no、doesn't have a 等
